description: Bigeye connector. Indexes Bigeye data-quality issues as `data_quality_test` items in the local index and exposes read tools (`bigeye_list`, `bigeye_get`, `bigeye_search`) plus HITL-gated issue-lifecycle write tools (`bigeye_issue_acknowledge`, `bigeye_issue_resolve`). Uses a Bearer API key against a per-tenant Bigeye instance. The per-tenant host is derived from bigeye.base_url at spawn time (like Looker/Tableau).
author: Nimbus
